fato_historico: 2019: Typhoon Hagibis makes landfall in Japan, killing 10 and forcing the evacuation of one million people.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to channel your inner warmth today. Just as nature reminds us of its immense, shifting power through the winds, consider how you might anchor your own spirit. It is a good time to embrace resilience and flow, letting your natural radiance guide you through any unexpected emotional turbulence or sudden changes in your environment.
frase_do_dia: True strength is the ability to remain warm even during the fiercest storms.
significado_numero: Represents the star of hope and lasting inner peace.
conselho: Stand tall, stay grounded, and trust in your innate ability to overcome challenges.
